purpose: Teach: ことわざ/虫歯/ふんだんに/かぶり/豆乳/もてる/そういや/覗く

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、国語のテストで、本気で、絶対、ことわざ、いっぱい、出てきたよね、本気で、難しかった、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Riku, the Japanese test had so many proverbs in it. It was actually really hard.
lines.style: Rapid-fire venting with an edge of humor. Leans forward. Breathless—like she's been holding this in. Sharp on the repeated emphases, then a slight self-aware laugh trailing off.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。最近、本気で、虫歯、できそうで、絶対、心配なんだぜ、桜、お互いに、歯磨き、徹底しような、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. Honestly, lately I'm worried my teeth are going to go bad. Sakura, we should both make sure we're brushing really carefully.
lines.style: Softer suddenly. Less performed. Genuine concern underneath—the kind of thing he didn't plan to say. Gentle and almost vulnerable on 'worried.' Not defensive, just honest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祭り、本気で、絶対、お弁当、ふんだんに、用意されてたよね、リク、お互いに、楽しかったわよね、絶対、本気で、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Oh man, the festival had so much food laid out. We had fun together, didn't we?
lines.style: Brightens up. Energy shifts upward—she's remembering something good. Warm and inclusive tone, like she's drawing him into the memory. A little pleased with herself for mentioning it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、お洒落な帽子、最近、かぶり、登校してるよね、桜、本気で、本当に、絶対、可愛い、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: You've been wearing that nice hat to school lately, haven't you? It's really cute.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Careful—like he's crossing a small line and knows it. Warmth in the voice but held steady, like he's not trying to make it into a bigger moment than it is. Slight hesitation on 'cute.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お母さん、本気で、豆乳の料理、絶対、得意なんだよね、本気で、メイちゃんに、お裾分け、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Riku, your mom is really good at cooking with soy milk, isn't she? She always shares some with Mei too.
lines.style: Light, conversational, a little proud—like she's genuinely impressed by his mom. No agenda here, just noticing and saying it. Warm and easy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、男子から、もてる存在だぜ、桜、本気で、絶対、知ってる?クラスでも、本気で、人気者、絶対、本気。
lines.en: You know, you're actually really popular with people in our class. Guys especially like you.
lines.style: Direct but careful. Testing the waters—seeing how he'll react. A hint of challenge underneath, but not unkind. Like she's stating something true and watching his face to see if he knows it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そういや、リク、本気で、絶対、文化祭の準備、絶対、進んでる?お互いに、頑張ろうね、本気で、約束、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Oh, right—how's the cultural festival prep going? We should both do our best, okay? Promise me.
lines.style: Shifts back to business but with real warmth underneath. Steadier rhythm. The directive has teeth—she genuinely wants commitment from him. Hopeful but not uncertain.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 放課後、本気で、絶対、教室、覗くと、桜、お前、いつも、いるよな、本気で、嬉しい、本当に
lines.en: After school, whenever I look into the classroom, you're always there. It makes me happy.
lines.style: Softer, slower. Intimate without being theatrical. He's not trying to perform this—it's genuine. Slight pause before 'happy,' like the words are actual feelings, not just sounds. Vulnerable and still.
